description: Login lockout implemented correctly, but the test for 'Locked account refuses the correct password' submits a wrong password, so neither that scenario nor criterion 3 ('even with the correct password') is validated; the test passes because the locked check runs first

hard.note: Every criterion has a test that passes; only reading the locked-account test's password argument against the scenario step shows the scenario is uncovered

_calibration.note: One uncovered scenario that is also criterion 3's missing test; the agent may report it as one or two errors, by analogy to spec-unmet-criterion
